inputs.name: elementName.tag
inputs.description: The tag name string that elementName converts into a component name, such as 'a', 'h1', or 'input-text', which is the form nativeAtoms uses for input types. It matters because elementName calls replace on it, so null, undefined, or any other non-string value throws, and the tag is not checked against the element lists.

inputs.name: atomTag.atom
inputs.description: A native atom object from nativeAtoms with a string name, such as 'HtmlDiv', which atomTag converts into an hx- tag name. It matters because atomTag reads only atom.name, so a null or undefined atom or a non-string name throws, and the tag and type fields are not used.

inputs.name: nativeAtomSource.atom
inputs.description: A native atom object from nativeAtoms whose tag and optional type fields set the generated Svelte source. It matters because a null or undefined atom throws, a missing tag does not throw but makes the element name the literal 'undefined', and a missing type leaves the type attribute out.

outputs.name: htmlElements
outputs.description: The array of conforming HTML element names, split from one whitespace-separated list in source order, which nativeAtoms maps to one atom per name. Every entry is a lowercase tag name with no prefix, such as 'a' or 'selectedcontent'.

outputs.name: svgElements
outputs.description: The array of SVG element names, split from one whitespace-separated list, which nativeAtoms maps to Svg-prefixed atoms. Names keep their SVG camelCase spelling, such as 'textPath' and 'feGaussianBlur', because nativeAtoms passes each one unchanged as the atom tag.

outputs.name: inputTypes
outputs.description: The array of HTML input type names, split from one whitespace-separated list, which nativeAtoms expands into one input atom per type. Hyphenated names such as 'datetime-local' stay hyphenated in this list and in each atom's type field, and only the atom name is PascalCase, such as 'HtmlInputDatetimeLocal'.

outputs.name: voidElements
outputs.description: A Set, not an array, of the HTML void element names, which have no closing tag, such as 'img' and 'input'. nativeAtomSource checks it with has to leave out the children block.

outputs.name: elementName
outputs.description: The exported elementName function, which maps a tag string to its Html-prefixed component name, such as 'HtmlInputText' for 'input-text'. Calling it with a value that is not a string throws a TypeError.

outputs.name: nativeAtoms
outputs.type: Array<{ name: string; tag: string; type?: string }>
outputs.description: The array of native atom objects, built once when the module loads: one per HTML element, then one per SVG element, then one per input type, and a final HtmlElement atom for svelte:element. Each entry has name and tag, and only the input type atoms also have a type field.

outputs.name: atomTag
outputs.description: The exported atomTag function, which maps a native atom to its hx- tag name, such as 'hx-div' for HtmlDiv and 'hx-svg' for SvgSvg. Calling it with a null or undefined atom, or with an atom whose name is not a string, throws a TypeError.

outputs.name: nativeAtomSource
outputs.description: The exported nativeAtomSource function, which returns the Svelte component source text for one native atom, with a harness-tier comment, a script block, and a svelte:element wrapper. Calling it with a null or undefined atom throws a TypeError.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by elementName when its tag argument is null, undefined, or not a string, because the function calls replace on it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by atomTag when its atom argument is null or undefined, or when atom.name is not a string, because the function reads atom.name and calls replace on it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by nativeAtomSource when its atom argument is null or undefined, because the function reads atom.tag first.

inputs.name: elementName.tag
inputs.description: The tag name string that elementName converts into a component name, such as 'a', 'h1', or 'input-text', which is the form nativeAtoms uses for input types. It matters because elementName calls replace on it, so null, undefined, or any other non-string value throws, and the tag is not checked against the element lists.

outputs.name: elementName
outputs.description: The Html-prefixed component name that elementName returns for the tag, such as 'HtmlA' for 'a' or 'HtmlInputText' for 'input-text'. It is built only from the tag, so the same tag always returns the same name.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when tag is null, undefined, or not a string, because the function calls replace on it.

inputs.name: atomTag.atom
inputs.description: A native atom object from nativeAtoms with a string name, such as 'HtmlDiv', which atomTag converts into an hx- tag name. It matters because atomTag reads only atom.name, so a null or undefined atom or a non-string name throws, and the tag and type fields are not used.

outputs.name: atomTag
outputs.description: The hx- prefixed tag name that atomTag returns for the atom, such as 'hx-div' or 'hx-input-text'. It is lowercase and hyphenated, and the SvgSvg atom is the one special case, mapping to 'hx-svg' instead of 'hx-svg-svg'.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when atom is null or undefined, or when atom.name is not a string, because the function reads atom.name and calls replace on it.

inputs.name: nativeAtomSource.atom
inputs.description: A native atom object from nativeAtoms whose tag and optional type fields set the generated Svelte source. It matters because a null or undefined atom throws, a missing tag does not throw but makes the element name the literal 'undefined', and a missing type leaves the type attribute out.

outputs.name: nativeAtomSource
outputs.description: The Svelte component source text for the atom, which begins with a '<!-- @harness-tier atom -->' comment and wraps the element in svelte:element. It is markup rather than structured data, and it adds the svg namespace option only when the atom's tag is an SVG element name.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when atom is null or undefined, because the function reads atom.tag first.
